# Environment Contract Checklist: Repository Environment Configuration

**Purpose**: Review whether the dotenv loading, exact-name contract, secrecy, and quality-gate
requirements are sufficiently complete and testable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark
an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all maintained process entry-point categories that must load the root `.env` explicitly bounded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the initial project-owned variable inventory complete across runtime, migration, test, validation, provider, and tracing concerns? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the tracked-template and ignored-local-file obligations both specified without leaving local dotenv variants ambiguous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Are documentation obligations defined for each affected repository surface and for the contributor workflow? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is “project-owned configuration” distinguished clearly from host-, tool-, test-harness-, and CI-owned inputs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the root-only loading boundary unambiguous for commands started outside the repository root? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 Are safe example values distinguished objectively from usable credentials, private paths, and connection strings? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is fail-closed handling of dynamic or otherwise unclassifiable environment reads defined clearly enough to avoid silently incomplete inventory results? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are process-precedence requirements consistent with the explicit-environment isolation required at test and subprocess boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003 and §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Are optional integration names required in `.env.example` consistently with the rule that their local values may remain blank? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases and §FR-005–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Are template grammar requirements consistent across malformed, duplicate, case-variant, and `export`-prefixed assignments? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases and §FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can exact inventory equality be measured independently as zero missing, extra, duplicate, malformed, or incorrectly named entries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Can value-blind diagnostics be objectively assessed for every failure category without exposing example, local, or process values? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009 and §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Are supported-host quality-gate expectations measurable for every host in the repository matrix? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011 and §SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are primary, missing-file, explicit-override, and non-root-working-directory acquisition scenarios all addressed? [Coverage, Spec §US1 and §FR-002–FR-004, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 Are missing, extra, duplicate, malformed, wrong-case, unsafe-placeholder, missing-template, and secret-canary contract scenarios all specified? [Coverage, Spec §US2–US3 and §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are failure outcomes defined so configuration errors preserve established validation and exit behavior while dotenv parse failures remain secret-safe? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-004 and §SC-006]

## Dependencies and Governance

- [ ] CHK018 Are the source-derived inventory, strict template parser, and ownership policy responsibilities separated without permitting a second hand-maintained source of truth? [Dependency, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Are documentation, strict typing, formatting, lint, tests, and single-root quality gates traceable to the applicable constitution principles? [Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK020 Are dependency versioning and lockfile expectations documented without weakening reproducibility across supported hosts? [Assumption, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify`
  and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
